unit.why: A short anecdote: a penitent comes to R. Zusha asking for a penance, and Zusha sends him to fast forty days in Ostroh before returning.

stories.start_quote: מעשה אירע ג״כ אצל אדמו״ר הה״ק
stories.summary_en: A penitent asks R. Zusha for a penance; Zusha tells him first to go to Ostroh and fast there forty days, then return so he can open the gate of repentance for him.
